text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Full of self-doubt, El Condor Pasa removes her iconic mask and disappears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to track her down, and find that she's convinced herself that she's a liar who hides her true face and puts on a front.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that all of her accomplishments are genuine, even if she was wearing a mask, and hand her mask back to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder offers further encouragement and El Condor Pasa gallantly redons her mask. The Phantom Bird is reborn!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets her sights back on the Japan Cup, with the Takarazuka Kinen as her next step along the way.
